// classification is retained across an edge, resolution, or read call.
#[inline(always)]
fn anchor_kind(value: Value<'_>) -> ResultG<u8> {
    match value {
        Value::Object(object) => match object.boxhead_graph_native() {
            NativeObject::None => Ok(0),
            NativeObject::Array(_) => Ok(1),
            native => anchor_native_kind_slow(native),
        },
        Value::MovieClip(_) => Ok(64),
        _ => Err(anchor_value_error()),
    }
}
